apple_ios.name: Cranamp
apple_ios.subtitle: Music player and skin editor
apple_ios.description:
Cranamp plays your music in a compact player with original Catamp pixel skins. Import compatible WSZ or ZIP skins, or make your own in Skin Studio.

MUSIC AND PLAYLISTS
Open local audio files or an audio stream URL. Import M3U, M3U8 and PLS playlists, search your tracks, and use shuffle or repeat. Export playlists as M3U files.

Play MP3, FLAC, WAV, AIFF, AAC-LC, ALAC, Ogg Vorbis and mono or stereo Ogg Opus files. Audio from MP4, MKV and WebM files works when the audio codec is supported. Some formats require a local playback copy. Protected files are not supported.

SOUND CONTROLS
Adjust the ten-band equalizer and preamp. Set volume and balance, and view a spectrum analyzer or oscilloscope.

PIXEL SKINS
Choose an original Catamp skin or import a compatible skin you have permission to use. Cranamp remembers your selected skin and playback settings.

No account, advertising or subscription is required. Bring your own audio files or stream URLs. Cranamp does not provide a commercial music catalogue.

SKIN STUDIO
Draw with pixel tools and paint layers. Edit exact colours, compare button states, and preview the result in the player. Change playlist and visualizer colours, build a bitmap font, edit window cutouts, and draw cursor artwork. Zoom and pan the canvas. The controls adapt to the available window width. Save layered CSTUDIO projects or export WSZ skins.

On iOS, HLS streams use system playback and do not support the equalizer, balance or visualizer. These controls work with supported local files and direct audio streams.
apple_ios.whats_new: Skin Studio now adapts to phone, tablet and desktop window sizes. Drawing tools show their current settings and rendered previews. Skin settings include exact playlist and visualizer colours, bitmap fonts, window cutouts and cursor editing. Added broader local audio import, including mono and stereo Ogg Opus. Improved canvas zoom and pan, file-picker cancellation and window layouts.
apple_ios.review_notes: Open Settings in the player, then Open Skin Studio. Choose Open working copy to edit the current skin, or Open skin or project to import a WSZ, ZIP or CSTUDIO file. Canvas contains drawing tools; Skin contains playlist and visualizer colours, bitmap font generation, window cutouts and cursor artwork. Save and share exports CSTUDIO or WSZ through the system file picker. Imported skins and projects contain image and settings data; they do not execute downloaded code. The store build has no self-update controls or installer capability. No login or purchase is needed. Test local playback with an audio file selected through the system picker. iOS does not include the desktop MCP server.
